review_boundary: Current effective local changes are preserved; superseded experiments are retained in Git history, not reintroduced into current source.

integration_decisions.item: Android package and renamed source files
integration_decisions.choice: Keep com.personal.piliplus and local PipCoordinator; map upstream Java helpers, DocumentsProvider, Utils and generated JNI references to this package.
Keep current explicit audio-service stop plus local PiP/diagnostic disposal. Upstream removal of stopService is not adopted because it changes the current shutdown behavior.
Keep HEVC then AVC defaults, saved old codec preferences, mediacodec, audio sync, 32 MB buffer, audio-track ordering and low-power mpv options.

Keep serialized ownership, cancellation, ready-owner heartbeat guard, native first-frame observer, stable output wait, cover handoff, route barrier and paused source restoration while adapting upstream interfaces.
Keep fixed viewport/canvas and mounted player subtree; local native coordinator remains responsible for both Android entry paths. Upstream iOS PiP is added.
Combine upstream stream preference and size detection with local ownership. Cancel listener on route leave and ignore frames belonging to another owner.
Force track upstream test/utils/accounts/deleted_account_test.dart; source content matches upstream.
Normal resolution and a subsequent isolated enforced-lockfile resolution both succeeded. pubspec.lock remains identical to upstream 2.1.6; no dependency version was changed.

Use a two-parent merge with original local tip as first parent and upstream 2.1.6 as second parent. Preserve a safety branch at the original local tip; do not rewrite local commits or include temporary WIP snapshot commits.
